# superset_user (Data Source)

Data source to read an existing user in Apache Superset by username or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_user" "admin" {
  username = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the user. If not specified, 'username' must be provided.
- `username` (String) The unique username of the user. If not specified, 'id' must be provided.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user account is active.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `roles` (List of Number) List of role IDs assigned to the user.
